name: independent-autobot-worker-contract-v1
purpose: Run ten production specialist lanes as independent long-lived GitHub jobs, each carrying verified candidate SHAs through repeated Builder -> QA/Reviewer cycles while preserving isolated edit, verification, recovery, handoff and operator-controlled integration contracts.

productionLane.changePolicy: No specialist candidate is automatically merged; central fan-in records every result and protected integration remains operator-controlled.

fanOut.dispatcher: planner/coordination layer chooses bot, objective, baseRef and coordinationId; once dispatched, the lane owns its own repeated cycle loop and does not wait for sibling lanes.
fanOut.isolation: Each specialist gets its own workflow run, isolated worktree, candidate branch, Aider execution and failure boundary.

workerLifecycle: isolated checkout and one-time runtime bootstrap
repeat: owned-file Aider edit from current verified base
repeat: local build and product-quality verification
repeat: independent QA and adversarial Reviewer
repeat: verified candidate SHA becomes the next lane base
repeat until the lane's requested run budget ends

fanIn.rule: Fan-in is an asynchronous evidence/telemetry collector for completed lane cycles. It must never gate a specialist's next productive cycle or require sibling lanes to finish.
fanIn.codeMerge: Candidate branches remain separate until a verified integration controller explicitly merges them against the recorded base SHA.

resourceIsolation.aider: one Aider process per active cycle inside one persistent specialist workflow; Aider is installed once per lane and Ollama/model runtime remains available across cycles.
resourceIsolation.model: Each production specialist owns its own local Ollama/model runtime; sibling workers never share an Aider/Ollama workspace.
resourceIsolation.failureBoundary: A failure in one specialist job must not cancel or contaminate sibling specialist jobs.
